questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of Even Functions?
questions.answer: An even function is symmetric about the vertical axis. In Fourier series on a symmetric interval, even functions have only cosine terms and a constant term.

questions.prompt: Show that f(x)=cos x is even and state the sine coefficients.
questions.answer: Evaluate at negative x: \[f(-x)=\cos(-x)=\cos x=f(x)\] Thus f is even. Since sin nx is odd, the product f(x) sin nx is odd, so \[b_n=\frac{1}{\pi}\int_{-\pi}^{\pi}f(x)\sin nx\,dx=0\]

questions.prompt: A centred detector pulse has left-right symmetry. Which Fourier terms can appear?
